case_title: NEW CENTURY FINANCIAL SERVICES, INC. VS. DAHLIA DELOSREYES

docket_entries.description: APPLICATION FOR ENTRY OF SISTER STATE JUDGMENT; NOTICE OF SISTER STATE JUDGMENT ISSUED FILED BY PLAINTIFF NEW CENTURY FINANCIAL SERVICES, INC. AS TO DEFENDANT DELOSREYES, DAHLIA JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED

UNDER APPLICATION TO THE CLERK FOR JUDGMENT UNDER SEC 1710.25 C.C.P., IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF NEW CENTURY FINANCIAL SERVICES, INC. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DELOSREYES, DAHLIA $5,183.90 PRINCIPAL, $101.85 INTEREST, $180.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,465.75, SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT ALL FURTHER PROCESSING TO BE DONE BY DEFAULT SECTION
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE
